scene_manager_scope.transition_handling: scene-local teardown followed by cut or short palette transition

memory_pool_map.lifecycle: static array reset on scene enter; slots activated and deactivated without heap
static array paired with obstacle slots
static burst slots for dust, impact and Pulse
fixed HUD fields and result card
single priority arbiter over PSG/XGM2 channels

dma_owners: small palette and scroll updates from scene_chase
vblank_dma_ownership.safety_pattern: all large resources preload on scene enter; gameplay uses SGDK queued operations and commits once through SYS_doVBlankProcess

window_ownership.decision: WINDOW owns the fixed compact top HUD; BG_A owns the lower climax letterbox bar.

channel_owners: XGM2 owns adaptive music when xgm2 asset is present
PSG channel 0 owns UI and jump cues
PSG channel 1 owns danger and Pulse cues
PSG noise channel owns impact and dust cues

save_system_contract_not_applicable: The slice has no persistent player progress; SRAM is reserved for canonical runtime evidence only.

region_timing_scope.justification: Gameplay timers scale from gApp.targetFps; NTSC 60 FPS is the performance gate and PAL remains functionally supported.

technique_selection.selection_rationale: The v009 techniques directly communicate Z-axis speed, articulated threat, phase escalation and physical impact while keeping a safe VBlank-only implementation path.
technique_selection.fallback_strategy: Prune far claw, one afterimage and cloud grafts before reducing road depth or returning to a monolithic pursuer.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Curve the road around a stable vanishing point and reinforce lane choice.
Move the lower road faster than the horizon to communicate forward travel.
application_plan.fallback: Keep line scroll and freeze vertical column offsets.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Make three discrete lanes readable inside a forced-perspective chase.
Create lane convergence and speed without affine hardware.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Integer Z-gain applied to HScroll and VSRAM tables.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Communicate impact and pursuer proximity while preserving player control.
application_plan.fallback: Reset to zero scroll and retain dust.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Make damage and successful Pulse use unambiguous to the player.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Short hitstop, shake, dust and cue.
application_plan.budget_evidence: runtime timing map and BlastEm motion evidence
application_plan.fallback: Use palette flash and dust without shake.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Make lane commitment and Pulse movement readable at high speed.
Give the pursuer weight and readable Z-axis attacks.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Parent torso with articulated head and claws.
application_plan.fallback: Hide the far claw while preserving head and striking claw.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Communicate pressure growth without runtime affine scaling.
application_plan.fallback: Use fewer scale stages tied to phase.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Protect critical silhouettes and obstacle readability.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Hide far claw, old ghost and cloud grafts under pressure.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Make celestial energy react to phase escalation.
Add controlled analog shimmer without competing with hazards.
application_plan.fallback: Use palette cycling at a slower cadence.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Separate the threat and Pulse during the climax.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Contextual VDP Shadow/Highlight state with slot audit.
application_plan.fallback: Disable mode and keep remastered high-contrast palette.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Focus attention during the final pressure phase.
application_plan.visual_or_audio_role: Expanded top WINDOW and lower BG_A bar.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Keep integrity, Pulse and pressure readable during road motion.
application_plan.budget_evidence: HUD screenshot and scene budget report
application_plan.fallback: Use a fixed BG_A safe area.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Prevent visual corruption and frame instability during the chase.
application_plan.fallback: Preload more assets at scene enter.

application_plan.gameplay_or_narrative_purpose: Signal escalation and escape state without obscuring obstacles.
application_plan.budget_evidence: BlastEm capture and visual VDP dump

rejected_or_deferred.reason: Active-display CRAM writes are hazardous experimental and conflict with the safe VBlank-only delivery contract.
rejected_or_deferred.reconsideration_gate: isolated benchmark plus BlastEm and hardware proof

rejected_or_deferred.reason: The safe route does not need an HBlank ISR and reserves H-Int ownership for future isolated experiments.
rejected_or_deferred.reconsideration_gate: isolated benchmark with owner and teardown

rejected_or_deferred.reason: The v009 route uses contextual Shadow/Highlight without a moving mask until scanline and palette behavior are proven.
rejected_or_deferred.reconsideration_gate: dedicated mask asset, slot audit and BlastEm proof

risk_mitigation_table.risk: Split background plus approved animation frames may exceed the usable tile budget.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: Measure the v007 split candidate, retain scene-local preload and reduce road overlay height before touching critical sprites.

risk_mitigation_table.risk: Sprite frame uploads, line scroll and palette changes may compete in VBlank.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: Use SGDK queued operations, small fixed updates and disable line scroll through the declared fallback when metrics regress.

risk_mitigation_table.risk: Hero, pursuer, obstacles, telegraphs and FX may exceed 20 sprites per scanline.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: Limit active object pools, stagger Y positions and hide inactive sprites vertically.

risk_mitigation_table.risk: Background, hero, pursuer and HUD may compete for the four CRAM palettes.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: Reserve PAL0 background, PAL1 hero, PAL2 pursuer/gameplay sprites and PAL3 HUD; mutate only documented accent slots.

risk_mitigation_table.risk: Music and high-priority feedback cues may mask danger or impact.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: Use a priority matrix with impact and Pulse above collection and UI cues.

risk_mitigation_table.risk: Pause or result transitions may leave the round without a valid continuation input.
risk_mitigation_table.mitigation: FSM tests cover pause/resume, victory/failure restart and return to menu.
